values.en: The unit normal $\boldsymbol{N}=X_{u}\times X_{v}/\lVert X_{u}\times X_{v}\rVert$ depends on the ordering of the two parameters: swapping $u$ and $v$ replaces $\boldsymbol{N}$ by $-\boldsymbol{N}$. A single local parametrization therefore orients only its own sheet, and the sign is a choice, not an intrinsic feature of the surface. Consistency of these local choices over a whole surface is not automatic: a regular surface need not be globally orientable, the Möbius band being the standard example. Statements about a global normal field require orientability, while the local unit normal is always available on a local sheet.
values.zh-CN: 单位法向量 $\boldsymbol{N}=X_{u}\times X_{v}/\lVert X_{u}\times X_{v}\rVert$ 依赖两个参数的次序：交换 $u$ 与 $v$ 会把 $\boldsymbol{N}$ 换成 $-\boldsymbol{N}$。因此单个局部参数化只对它自己的开片给出定向，符号是一种选择，而非曲面的内禀特征。这些局部选择能否在整个曲面上相容并不自动成立：正则曲面不必整体可定向，Möbius 带是标准例子。关于整体法向量场的陈述需要可定向性，而局部单位法向量在局部开片上总是存在的。
